name: Ingrid Lindgren
scenario_title: Fika Invitation from an Old Friend
action: Ingrid texts Karin back warmly, saying she’d love to meet for fika and can be at the café near Gamla Stan soon.
reason: Her first impulse was to answer warmly and make room for the meeting, while still feeling the pull of the unfinished estimates. Reflection STRENGTHENED that inclination by making Karin seem like one of the few friendships left separate from hotel, inheritance, and duty, and by bringing her mother’s emphasis on preserving youth friendships into the decision. Although the work on Ingrid’s desk and her habit of returning to the business remain the main competing influence, the revised tendency makes the brief visit feel worth protecting, so she sends an accepting, friendly text rather than declining or delaying.
